name: testimonial-carousel
title: Testimonial Carousel
description: One testimonial at a time with previous and next buttons, dots, a counter and arrow keys. No autoplay.

props.name: title
props.description: The section headline. Labels the section for assistive tech.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; quote: string; name: string; role?: string; company?: string }[]

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: Index of the slide shown first.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called with the new index whenever the slide changes.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds a slide takes to change.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
